name: Dense data
summary: Compact, exact and quiet, for analysts who scan alerts and compare signals all day.
useWhen: Security operations, threat detection, model monitoring, admin panels and analytics: many records, daily expert users, mouse and keyboard.

name: Content first
summary: Large, calm type and generous space, for people who come to read.
useWhen: Publications, documentation, blogs, guides and help centers.

name: Accessible first
summary: Large text, large targets and AAA contrast, so everyone can finish the task.
useWhen: Public services, health, government and any product that must work for everyone.

name: Brand expressive
summary: Big display type, vivid color and springy motion, for launches that must be remembered.
useWhen: Launch sites, campaigns, marketing pages and consumer brands that lead with personality.

name: Multi-brand
summary: Customer screens for several brands, often on phones: sign-up, checkout, account. Components never change; brand primitives do.
useWhen: Companies that sell to customers under several brands, or white-label products shown to their clients' customers: sign-up, checkout, account and product pages.
